public_rationale: Marcus predicted on January 1, 2025, with high confidence, that copyright lawsuits over generative AI would continue throughout the year. Publishers sued Cohere on February 13, 2025. On November 13, 2025 the court in that case denied a motion to dismiss and said more than fifty such lawsuits were before the courts.
limitations: The record shows suits pending in February and November 2025. It does not count every suit filed or decided in 2025.
'More than fifty' is the court's count. This record does not check it independently.
